topic: A rose bud opening into a full rose

episode.title: From Tiny Bud to Perfect Rose 🌹

shots.scene: Beautiful photorealistic macro photograph of one pink rose bud on a slender stem in a garden, tightly enclosed by green sepals with a small pink tip visible. Fixed three-quarter side angle, bud centered in the lower middle with generous space above and beside it for the eventual bloom, softly blurre
shots.action: Show the compact, closed bud with its green sepals held snugly against it.

shots.scene: Beautiful photorealistic macro photograph of the same single pink rose bud on the same slender stem in the same garden position. shots.action: Change only the sepals: bend them outward from the still tightly closed pink bud.

Identical fixed three-quarter side angle, framing, scale, softly blurred sage-green background, and soft natural morning light, vertical 9:16. Green sepals remain parted benea
shots.action: Change only the outermost petal edges: separate them slightly from the tightly wrapped bud.

Identical fixed three-quarter side angle, framing, scale, softly blurred sage-green background, and soft natural morning light, vertical 9:16. Parted green sepals sit beneath
shots.action: Change only the outermost petals: unfold them outward into a small cup.
